name: What should I do first in a kitchen remodel plan?

mainEntity.name: What is the first step when planning a kitchen remodel so I do not waste money?
mainEntity.text: What is the first step when planning a kitchen remodel so I do not waste money?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best first step is not picking tile or appliances. It is defining the purpose of the remodel. Decide whether the goal is better storage, a more open layout, improved resale value, or a full luxury transformation. Once the goal is clear, set a realistic budget range and list the non-negotiables. After that, measure the existing kitchen carefully and identify constraints such as plumbing locations, wall conditions, ceiling height, and utility access. Those facts shape what is possible before design decisions get expensive. Homeowners who start with the right priorities usually make better tradeoffs and avoid redesign work later. In a market like Los Angeles, where material and labor costs can climb quickly, disciplined planning is one of the best ways to protect the budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by defining the goal of the remodel, the budget range, and the must-have changes before choosing materials. Then measure the space, identify layout constraints, and compare contractor or designer proposals based on the same scope. Good planning prevents expensive changes later.
